(only in Siddh.) or वीटा f. a small piece of wood shaped like a barley-corn and about a span long (it was struck with a stick or bat in a kind of game, like tip-cat, played by boys; accord. to some it was a kind of metal ball; others say it was held in the mouth as a form of penance), MBh. i, 5050 (Sch.) &c.
वीटक n. (also written बीटक) a preparation of the Areca nut with spices and lime rolled up together in a leaf of the betel plant (commonly called betel or Pān), Pañcad.
वीट—मुख (वीटा-) mfn. holding the Vīṭā in the mouth, VP.
